name: Triage trust and safety reports with Jev Classification, Google Sheets, Gmail, Telegram, and gpt-6-luna

parameters.content:
## Trust and safety report triage

### How it works

A report form posts to the Report Intake webhook. Normalize Report keeps the fields the policy needs, and the Report Text Usable? guard marks a textless submission incomplete, emails ops and stops there.

Usable text goes to Jev Classification with fixed categories, a 0.6 confidence threshold and Send to Needs Review Output for uncertain calls. Each of the six outputs lands on its own route Set with the business decision: queue, SLA hours, priority, required action and status.

Every route appends one row to the Report Triage tab, then pages a human on Telegram or emails the owner. A Monday schedule turns that tab into a short ops brief.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Point your form or helpdesk webhook at the Report Intake webhook (POST).
- [ ] Attach the Jev (TypeSafe) API, Google Sheets, Gmail and Telegram credentials.
- [ ] Replace the placeholder addresses and the Telegram chat id.
- [ ] Adjust queues, SLAs and owners in the route Set nodes.

### Customization

- Add categories, or mirror the report log into Slack, Linear or Jira.
- Change the 0.6 confidence threshold on the classification node.

categories.description: Targeted abuse, harassment or a threat of violence against a person or group.
Deceptive offers, phishing, fake giveaways, payment or investment fraud.
Content suggesting the author may be at risk of self-harm or suicide. Time critical.
Promotional spam, repeated noise or content that breaks relevance rules only.
The reported content does not break any content policy.

parameters.content:
## Intake guard

Report Intake normalises the payload, then the Report Text Usable? IF checks the report text. Empty text goes to Mark Incomplete Report plus an ops email, and the run ends there. Usable text goes straight into Jev Classification.

## Outcome routing and logging

Each of the six Jev outputs has its own route Set with queue, SLA, priority and action. Every route appends one row to the Report Triage tab, then pages or emails the owner. Spam is logged and batched only.

## Weekly brief lane

Monday 09:00 reads the Report Triage tab, counts rows per category, lets the agent draft the brief and emails it to the ops inbox.
